description: Easy: create a small file tree with exact contents.
prompt:
Create the following files with these EXACT contents (no extra text; a single trailing newline is OK):
1. work/term-01/tree/alpha.txt -> "alpha-1"
2. work/term-01/tree/beta/gamma.txt -> "gamma-2"
3. work/term-01/notes.txt -> "done"
Create parent directories as needed. Use only local shell commands (e.g. PowerShell New-Item / Set-Content, or node/python one-liners). No network, no installs.
title: Create file tree
